message.content: {":items": [{"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "Lowest RMSE among passing structures (0.00575), well within tolerance, and uses all 16 usable observations, indicating the best fit without overfitting relative to simpler models.", "evidence_refs": ["passing[4]"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "Second-lowest RMSE (0.00627) and within tolerance; simpler than the triple hypothesis while capturing bias and speed step effects.", "evidence_refs": ["passing[2]"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP,ACTUATOR_DELAY)", "rationale": "Third-lowest RMSE (0.00651) and within tolerance; adds actuator delay to bias and speed step but does not improve as much as the velocity-offset triple.", "evidence_refs": ["passing[6]"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET)", "rationale": "RMSE 0.00961 within tolerance; captures bias and velocity offset but omits speed step, fitting less well than structures including SPEED_STEP.", "evidence_refs": ["passing[1]"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,ACTUATOR_DELAY)", "rationale": "RMSE 0.00977 within tolerance; similar to the double bias+velocity model but with actuator delay, fitting worse than speed-step-inclusive alternatives.", "evidence_refs": ["passing[5]"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "SENSOR_BIAS", "rationale": "RMSE 0.01451 within tolerance; simplest single-factor model but higher error than combined structures.", "evidence_refs": ["passing[0]"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,ACTUATOR_DELAY)", "rationale": "RMSE 0.01462 within tolerance; bias plus actuator delay, but higher error than velocity-offset or speed-step combinations.", "evidence_refs": ["passing[3]"]}]}
